title: Data Whisperer: Efficient Data Selection for Task-Specific LLM Fine-Tuning via Few-Shot In-Context Learning
authors_zh: Shaobo Wang, Xiangqi Jin, Ziming Wang, Jize Wang, Jiajun Zhang, Kaixin Li, Zichen Wen, Zhong Li, Conghui He, Xuming Hu, Linfeng Zhang
paper_type_zh: 免训练的任务数据选择研究
best_for_zh: 适合能够查看模型注意力、却无力承担目标语料评分微调成本的任务特定监督微调子集选择者。
one_line: Data Whisperer selects task-specific fine-tuning records by measuring how attention-weighted few-shot demonstrations improve query performance before any scoring-model training.
Data Whisperer 在任何评分模型训练之前，衡量带注意力权重的少样本示例如何改善查询表现，并据此选择任务微调记录。
why: It makes pre-training ICL behavior an explicit training-record utility signal and evaluates selection cost relative to the full fine-tuning budget.
inclusion_reason: It turns task records into attention-weighted ICL demonstrations and makes their measured contribution determine which records reach fine-tuning.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Selecting a small task-specific fine-tuning set can save substantial training cost, but many selectors first fine-tune a scoring model on the same target collection. The selection pass can then cost as much as or more than training on the full dataset, while simple gradient or heuristic scores do not fully use the predictive behavior of the model that will eventually be fine-tuned.

The paper asks whether a pre-trained model can score training records without a separate target-data training phase. It uses each candidate record as a few-shot demonstration, measures how well the model answers held-out queries in that context, and treats the result as evidence of the record's training utility. Attention weighting is added because a demonstration's influence depends on its position and interaction with queries.

选择一个较小的任务特定微调集合可以节省大量训练成本，但许多选择器会先在同一目标集合上微调一个评分模型。这样一轮选择的成本可能等于甚至超过全量数据训练，而简单的梯度或启发式分数也没有充分利用最终将被微调的模型本身的预测行为。

论文要回答的是，预训练模型能否在无需单独目标数据训练阶段的情况下为训练记录评分。它把每个候选记录作为少样本示例，衡量模型在该上下文中回答留出查询的效果，并将结果视为记录训练效用的证据。由于示例的影响取决于其位置及其与查询的交互，方法又加入了注意力加权。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Data Whisperer uses in-context learning as a proxy for fine-tuning influence. A candidate example appears among a small group of demonstrations, the model predicts answers for separate queries, and the measured accuracy or ROUGE score is initially credited to every demonstration in that context. Repeating these trials lets every record accumulate an empirical demonstration score without updating any model weights.

The key refinement is to distribute credit by attention. The method reads a selected layer's attention from the first prediction token to each demonstration, normalizes for example length, and weights the trial score accordingly. A record is therefore selected not only because it appeared in a successful few-shot context, but because the model attended to it while answering those queries; averaged weighted scores determine the final top-k subset.

Data Whisperer 将上下文学习用作微调影响的代理。一个候选例子出现在一小组示例中，模型为另外的查询预测答案，测得的准确率或 ROUGE 分数起初会记到该上下文中的每个示例上。重复这些试验使每条记录都能累积经验性的示例分数，而无需更新任何模型权重。

关键改进是按注意力分配贡献。方法读取某一选定层从第一个预测词元到每个示例的注意力，按示例长度归一化，并相应地加权试验分数。因此，一条记录被选择不仅因为它出现在成功的少样本上下文中，也因为模型在回答这些查询时确实关注了它；平均后的加权分数决定最终 top-k 子集。

title: Method
方法
html:
Each iteration samples disjoint demonstration and query groups from the task dataset and places the demonstrations after a fixed instruction. The pre-trained scoring model generates query answers; exact match scores GSM8K and ROUGE-L scores DialogSum and BioInstruct. The average query score is initially associated with every demonstration in that context, and repeated appearances are later averaged.

For each demonstration, the method sums self-attention from the selected layer and all heads between its tokens and all query tokens, then normalizes by the demonstration length. This attention weight refines its credited score. The main study uses ten demonstrations and five queries by default, selects a budgeted top-k subset, and LoRA-fine-tunes Llama-3-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, or Mistral-Nemo for five epochs; smaller same-family models can perform the scoring.

每次迭代从任务数据集中抽取互不重叠的示例组和查询组，并把示例放在固定指令之后。预训练评分模型生成查询答案；GSM8K 使用精确匹配评分，DialogSum 和 BioInstruct 使用 ROUGE-L 评分。平均查询分数先与该上下文中的每个示例相关联，随后对重复出现的记录求平均。

对于每个示例，方法把选定层和所有注意力头中、其词元与所有查询词元之间的自注意力求和，再按示例长度归一化。这个注意力权重细化其所获分数。主要研究默认使用十个示例和五个查询，选择预算约束的 top-k 子集，并对 Llama-3-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B 或 Mistral-Nemo 进行五轮 LoRA 微调；同一模型族中更小的模型也可以执行评分。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
For Llama-3-8B-Instruct, Data Whisperer using 10% of GSM8K reaches 72.46 exact match, exceeding random selection at 69.66 and the reported full-data result at 71.39. On DialogSum and BioInstruct at the same 10% budget it reaches 42.18 and 39.20 ROUGE-L, versus random 41.45 and 38.70. The paper reports that it consistently exceeds the listed selection baselines across these tasks and several subset ratios.

The cost analysis is central evidence: on Llama-3-8B, the reported selection-to-tuning ratio is 0.13–0.17 for GSM8K, compared with 1.22–1.26 for Nuggets, giving 7.41–9.38 times speedup. Attention ablations show intermediate layers are usually most stable and weak-to-strong scoring retains performance while lowering cost. These are task-specific controlled experiments, not evidence that the same score transfers to inaccessible closed models.

对于 Llama-3-8B-Instruct，Data Whisperer 使用 GSM8K 的 10% 达到 72.46 的精确匹配，超过随机选择的 69.66 和报告的全量数据结果 71.39。在相同 10% 预算下，它在 DialogSum 和 BioInstruct 上分别达到 42.18 和 39.20 的 ROUGE-L，而随机选择为 41.45 和 38.70。论文报告它在这些任务和若干子集比例上持续超过所列选择基线。

成本分析是核心证据：在 Llama-3-8B 上，报告的 GSM8K 选择—微调比为 0.13–0.17，而 Nuggets 为 1.22–1.26，速度提高 7.41–9.38 倍。注意力消融显示中间层通常最稳定，弱到强评分在降低成本的同时保留性能。这些是任务特定的对照实验，并非证明同一分数可迁移到无法访问内部状态的封闭模型。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is not merely a faster top-k filter. It changes the record-level selection signal from a proxy such as gradient norm to the candidate's observed role in a simulated few-shot learning episode. The attention term further attributes a shared query outcome to demonstrations according to the model's actual contextual use of each one.

It also introduces selection-to-tuning ratio as a decision boundary for whether a data selector is operationally worthwhile. A selector that improves a subset but costs longer than fine-tuning the full dataset may not be a useful training-data intervention. This framing couples record quality, selection expense, and the eventual SFT consumer in one measurable pipeline.

贡献不只是一个更快的 top-k 过滤器。它将记录级选择信号从梯度范数之类的代理，改为候选记录在模拟少样本学习过程中的已观察作用。注意力项又依据模型实际如何在上下文中使用每个示例，将共享的查询结果归因给各个示例。

它还提出选择—微调比，作为一个数据选择器在操作上是否值得使用的决策边界。一个能改善子集、却比全量数据微调花费更久的选择器，可能不是有用的训练数据干预。这一框架将记录质量、选择费用和最终监督微调消费者耦合进一个可测量的流程。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The selector requires access to internal attention tensors, so it cannot directly operate on many API-only models. Its scores also depend on task-specific prompt templates and automatic metrics; a metric that poorly reflects deployment quality can select the wrong records. The reported study covers models near 3B–12B and four tasks, leaving much larger models, multilingual data, and other training objectives untested. The method often prefers lower-perplexity examples at small budgets, which may reduce rare-case coverage; upstream dataset terms and the repository implementation need separate review before reuse.
选择器需要访问内部注意力张量，因此不能直接运行在许多仅提供 API 的模型上。其分数还依赖任务特定的提示模板和自动指标；若指标不能良好反映部署质量，就可能选错记录。报告的研究覆盖约 3B–12B 的模型和四项任务，把更大的模型、多语言数据及其他训练目标留作未检验问题。方法在小预算下常偏好低困惑度例子，可能降低罕见情况覆盖；复用前还需单独审查上游数据条款和仓库实现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This is essential for teams that need an efficient task-data selection baseline before SFT and have white-box access to their models. It provides an auditable chain from a record's few-shot contribution, through attention attribution, to inclusion under a fixed budget, and releases code. It is especially useful when selection cost itself is a constraint; record the exact prompts, metrics, scoring layer, model checkpoint, random sampling schedule, and subset ratio before comparing it with gradient-based or diversity-oriented alternatives.
对于需要在监督微调前建立高效任务数据选择基线、且能以白盒方式访问模型的团队，这是一篇必读论文。它提供了从记录的少样本贡献、经过注意力归因、到固定预算下纳入决策的可审计链条，并发布了代码。当选择成本本身是约束时它尤其有用；在与梯度式或多样性导向替代方案比较前，应记录准确提示、指标、评分层、模型检查点、随机抽样日程和子集比例。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Sections 3 and 4 jointly. Section 3 defines what a score means: it is a repeated, attention-weighted ICL contribution rather than a direct estimate of label quality. Section 4 then supplies the default demonstration/query counts, task metrics, LoRA setup, and selection-to-tuning calculation needed to interpret the claimed speedups. The ablation without attention is important because the method's score-sharing assumption can otherwise confound a productive context with the contribution of every record in it. The public repository should be used to verify implementation defaults and data preprocessing.
应将第 3 节和第 4 节结合阅读。第 3 节定义了分数含义：它是重复得到、经注意力加权的上下文学习贡献，而不是标签质量的直接估计。第 4 节则提供解释所称加速所需的默认示例／查询数量、任务指标、LoRA 设置和选择—微调计算。没有注意力的消融很重要，因为该方法的分数共享假设否则可能将一个有效上下文与其中每条记录的贡献混淆。应使用公开仓库核验实现默认值和数据预处理。

value.html: Task-specific records from GSM8K, DialogSum, BioInstruct, and a synthetic DialogSum variant.
Input-output record, demonstration appearance, query performance score, attention weight, averaged selection score, and top-k inclusion decision.
Existing input-output records are repeatedly used as ICL demonstrations and receive performance and attention-derived selection scores.
Task-specific LoRA fine-tuning after pre-training-stage ICL-based selection.
Exact match for GSM8K and ROUGE-L for DialogSum and BioInstruct score the ICL queries.
The highest averaged attention-weighted demonstration scores form a budgeted top-k training subset.
Llama-3-8B-Instruct, Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct, and Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407.
The same or a smaller model from the same family performs pre-training ICL scoring; no target-dataset scoring fine-tune is used.
No new records are generated for the primary selection procedure.
Randomly sample disjoint demonstration and query sets, score query performance, weight demonstrations by a selected attention layer, and repeat until all records are scored.
Average context-aware ICL demonstration scores across appearances and retain top-k records at the chosen budget.
The default ablation uses 10 demonstrations and 5 queries; selection-to-tuning ratios are measured on eight A100 GPUs.
LoRA fine-tuning for five epochs, repeated three times.
Three public task datasets plus one manually reviewed synthetic DialogSum variant.
The paper reports task-specific training and test splits, but their licenses and exact preprocessed files require verification from upstream sources and the repository.
No comprehensive benchmark-contamination audit is reported.
